i_bottlecap.lore.epic: Was flicked so hard in a game of tiddlywinks that it bounced off the fridge, the kettle and the cat's bell.
i_bottlecap.lore.legendary: Was flicked so hard that it skimmed across the lake eleven times and landed in a fisherman's sandwich.

x_carafe.lore.rare: Turns plain tap water fizzy whenever a waiter is rude to it, and sprays the rude one.
x_carafe.lore.legendary: Kept the water at a summer wedding so cold that the ice sculpture asked to stand next to it.

x_decanter.lore.epic: Popped its stopper at a quiet dinner, and the stopper rolled under the table into Grandad's slipper, where it stayed till spring.
x_decanter.lore.legendary: Threw a rainbow so bright across the dining room that it bent round the door and coloured the hall carpet for good.

x_drinking_bottle.lore.rare: Leaks only inside schoolbags, and only onto homework that is due today.
x_drinking_bottle.lore.legendary: Was refilled so often that it learned to fill itself at every tap it passed, and the plumber now knows it by name.

x_hip_flask.lore.rare: Keeps its cocoa so hot that the snow melts in a circle round anyone holding it.
x_hip_flask.lore.epic: Slipped out of a pocket at the top of a ski slope and slid all the way down ahead of the family.
x_hip_flask.lore.legendary: Poured cocoa so hot onto a frozen lake that it melted a perfect circle, and the ducks now use it as a hot tub.

x_kombucha_bottle.lore.rare: Grows a new cloudy blob inside every night, and the blob has started waving.
x_kombucha_bottle.lore.legendary: Was left to brew so long that the cloudy blob inside learned to read, and now it writes the shopping list.

x_milk_bottle.lore.uncommon: Clinks against the other bottles on the doorstep and wakes the dog every morning.
x_milk_bottle.lore.epic: Was carried off down the street by a blue tit that refused to let go of the foil top.
x_milk_bottle.lore.legendary: Was delivered through a blizzard so deep that the milk float had to tunnel, and it still beat the postman.

i_nipple.lore.epic: Fed a baby so fast at midnight that the burp afterwards rattled the windows.
i_nipple.lore.legendary: Fed a baby so happily that her first big burp blew out every candle on her birthday cake.

x_sippy_cup.lore.rare: Bounces back up onto the highchair tray every time it is thrown, like a yo-yo.
x_sippy_cup.lore.legendary: Was thrown from the highchair so far that it landed in another country, and a toddler there threw it back.

x_sports_bottle_cap.lore.rare: Pops itself open at the exact moment the bottle is upside down in a bag.
x_sports_bottle_cap.lore.epic: Squirted so far at half-time that it soaked the referee's whistle, and the match was finished by shouting.

x_beer_can.lore.uncommon: Gets kicked down the street by everyone who passes until it finally reaches a recycling bin.
x_beer_can.lore.rare: Uncrushes itself in the recycling bin overnight, so the bin is always full by morning.
x_beer_can.lore.epic: Clattered into the recycling lorry so loudly that the lorry jumped and dropped a whole week of bottles.

x_cola.lore.rare: Makes the ice cubes jump out of the glass like popcorn and skid across the table.
x_cola.lore.legendary: Fizzed so hard when opened that the bottle shot over the school like a rocket, and the caretaker caught it on the roof.

can.lore.rare: Rings like a dinner bell when tapped, so the dog thinks it is dinner time all day long.
can.lore.legendary: Stood up to a steamroller and won, so the road now has a can-shaped bump in it.

x_soda.lore.rare: Shakes itself up in the fridge whenever it hears someone coming.
x_soda.lore.legendary: Fizzed for a hundred years in a time capsule, and when it was dug up it sprayed the whole school assembly.

x_lobster_dish.lore.epic: Waved one claw so convincingly at a seaside dinner that the waiter shook its hand.
x_lobster_dish.lore.legendary: Snapped its claws so loudly at a seaside feast that every crab on the beach came to see who was in charge.

x_cocktail_glass_drink.lore.rare: Opens its little paper umbrella whenever rain is coming, which has saved several picnics.
x_cocktail_glass_drink.lore.epic: Had so much fruit on its rim that a parrot landed on it and refused to leave the garden party.
x_cocktail_glass_drink.lore.legendary: Opened its paper umbrella so wide in a storm that the whole beach sheltered underneath it.

x_water_glass.lore.rare: Moves itself to the exact spot where a sleepy hand will knock it.
x_water_glass.lore.epic: Was knocked over in the night so neatly that it watered the bedroom plant, which flowered by morning.
x_water_glass.lore.legendary: Held its water so still all night that the Moon came down to check its reflection in it.

x_wine.lore.common: Is dark red grape juice in a fancy glass, swirled round and round by anyone pretending to be posh.
x_wine.lore.epic: Was spilled at a dinner party so artistically that the stain was framed and hung in the hall.
x_wine.lore.legendary: Left a stain on the tablecloth so big and purple that explorers mistook it for a map and set off to find the island.

hotdog.lore.rare: Slides out of its bun and tries to escape whenever someone opens their mouth.
hotdog.lore.legendary: Grew so long on the grill that it stretched out of the stadium, and the fans at the far end got the other half.

x_baby_food_jar.lore.legendary: Made a fussy baby eat every spoonful by turning into a rocket, and the baby's first word was 'more'.

x_caviar.lore.epic: Was spilled at a posh party, and the guests crawled round the carpet with tiny spoons.
x_caviar.lore.legendary: Popped so loudly at a posh party that the guests thought it was fireworks and rushed into the garden in their best clothes.

x_cookie_jar.lore.rare: Moves itself to a higher shelf every time a hand reaches for it.
x_cookie_jar.lore.legendary: Clattered its lid so loudly in the night that a burglar dropped everything and ran off with only a biscuit.

x_dip.lore.rare: Hides one crisp at the bottom and sinks any crisp that dives in to rescue it.
x_dip.lore.epic: Was dipped into so fast at a party that the bowl spun round like a record player.
x_dip.lore.legendary: Was still full at midnight, so the guests went home and the dip threw a party of its own.

x_honey.lore.rare: Draws a golden spiral on anything it is poured on, and nobody can pour it straight.
x_honey.lore.legendary: Was found in an ancient pyramid still perfect, and the explorers had it on toast for lunch.

x_honey_jar.lore.uncommon: Lets its wooden dipper slide down inside, so fishing it out means honey up to the elbow.
x_honey_jar.lore.epic: Was opened at a picnic, and a bear came out of the woods with its own spoon.
x_honey_jar.lore.legendary: Tipped over and held the whole village in place for a day, stuck to the street, and nobody minded.

x_hummus.lore.rare: Makes any vegetable dipped in it taste like a crisp, so the carrots now get stolen first.
x_hummus.lore.epic: Was swirled so hard that the oil in the middle became a whirlpool and swallowed a whole cucumber.
x_hummus.lore.legendary: Was so smooth that the chickpeas in the next tin asked to be made into it straight away.

x_jam.lore.rare: Jumps off the knife onto the nearest clean shirt like a sticky frog.
x_jam.lore.legendary: Was boiled so long that it set into one strawberry the size of a car.

jar.lore.rare: Remembers what was last kept in it, so the cookies always taste faintly of pickles.
jar.lore.legendary: Kept the smell of one summer's day sealed inside, and opening it in winter makes everyone reach for sunglasses.

x_nutella.lore.rare: Hides behind the jam whenever a grown-up opens the cupboard, and comes out again for a child.
x_nutella.lore.epic: Left a chocolate moustache on the whole family at breakfast on school photo day.
x_nutella.lore.legendary: Was spread so smoothly that the hazelnut tree in the garden started growing jars instead of nuts.

x_peanut_butter.lore.rare: Turns crunchy or smooth depending on what its eater did not want.
x_peanut_butter.lore.epic: Glued a jigsaw puzzle together so firmly that the family hung it on the wall as a picture.
x_peanut_butter.lore.legendary: Stuck the clapper of the school bell so firmly that it now rings only on Saturdays.

x_pickle_jar.lore.common: Floats its pickles to the top whenever a fork goes in, and sinks them the moment it is gone.
x_pickle_jar.lore.rare: Turns anything dropped into it into a pickle, so the lost earring is now a very sour gherkin.
x_pickle_jar.lore.epic: Was opened on a bumpy bus, and a pickle shot out and landed in the driver's top pocket.
x_pickle_jar.lore.legendary: Puckered the whole town with one sniff, and every face stayed squeezed until teatime.

x_salsa.lore.epic: Was so spicy at a party that the ice in everyone's drinks melted at once.
x_salsa.lore.legendary: Was so spicy that the tortilla chips started wearing oven gloves to dip into it.

x_spice_jar.lore.rare: Swaps labels with the jar next to it whenever the cupboard door is shut.
x_spice_jar.lore.legendary: Seasoned one stew so well that the pot asked to be washed less often so it could keep the taste.

milk_carton.lore.rare: Goes sour exactly one day before the date on its side, every single time.
milk_carton.lore.epic: Was opened from the wrong side, and the milk shot across the table straight into the cat's open mouth.
milk_carton.lore.legendary: Stayed fresh so long that its date changed to 'never', and the fridge started treating it with respect.

x_hot_chocolate.lore.rare: Makes marshmallows float up out of the mug and bob round the room like little balloons.
x_hot_chocolate.lore.epic: Was whipped so frothy after a snowball fight that the froth climbed out of the mug and sat on Dad's head like a hat.
x_hot_chocolate.lore.legendary: Was stirred so fast that it made a chocolate whirlpool, and a whole bag of marshmallows rode round it like a fairground ride.

x_tea.lore.uncommon: Gets brewed with the teabag left in so long that it turns the colour of a brick.
x_tea.lore.rare: Heats itself up again whenever anyone in the house gets bad news.
x_tea.lore.epic: Was brewed so strong in the urn for the street party that the bunting stood straight out like flags.
x_tea.lore.legendary: Was so comforting that a grumpy bus driver drank a cup and drove everyone round town for free.

x_salt.lore.rare: Makes the sea a little saltier every time it is spilled, and the fish have started complaining.
x_salt.lore.epic: Was thrown over a shoulder for luck so hard that it landed in the soup in the next room.
x_salt.lore.legendary: Salted the whole sea in one shake, which is why it tastes like that.

salt_shaker.lore.rare: Gives out pepper when salt is asked for, and salt when pepper is, on purpose.
salt_shaker.lore.epic: Sneezed out every grain at once when the pepper came near, and the dinner table had a blizzard.
salt_shaker.lore.legendary: Shook out a single grain so perfectly that the whole meal tasted better, and the chef retired on the spot.

x_spices.lore.rare: Makes any dish taste of the last place its cook went on holiday, even porridge.
x_spices.lore.epic: Got spilled on the barbecue and sent up a cloud so colourful that the neighbours thought a festival had started.
x_spices.lore.legendary: Flavoured a single grain of rice so strongly that it fed a whole village, one sniff each.

spray_bottle.lore.rare: Squirts the window that has just been cleaned, so it always needs doing again.
spray_bottle.lore.epic: Was used in a garden water fight so fiercely that it made a rainbow over the fence, and the neighbours came out for photos.
spray_bottle.lore.legendary: Kept a cactus so happy that it grew a flower the size of an umbrella, and the family took it to the beach.

sushi.lore.rare: Wobbles the fish on top whenever soy sauce comes near, as if it is ticklish.
sushi.lore.legendary: Was rolled so long that it went all the way round the restaurant like a conveyor belt of its own.

thermos.lore.rare: Keeps cold things cold and hot things hot, and gets very confused by ice cream on a hot day.
thermos.lore.legendary: Kept its tea hot through a whole polar winter, and the explorers used it to warm their toes.

vase.lore.rare: Grows back any flower in it the moment it wilts, so the same daisy has lived on the windowsill for years.
vase.lore.legendary: Was knocked off the shelf by a football and floated gently back up, landing exactly where it was with the flowers still in.

wine_bottle.lore.epic: Crashed into the bottle bank so tunefully that a busker asked to borrow it.
wine_bottle.lore.legendary: Was turned into a ship in a bottle so detailed that the tiny sailors started sending messages out.

x_aerosol.lore.rare: Hisses back at anyone who shakes it too hard, like a grumpy cat.
x_aerosol.lore.epic: Was pressed by mistake in a tiny cupboard and made the coats smell of lemons for a whole winter.
x_aerosol.lore.legendary: Sputtered its last puff so dramatically that the family gave it a farewell speech, and then it sprayed once more.

x_air_freshener.lore.uncommon: Runs out of smell the day before visitors arrive, every time.
x_air_freshener.lore.rare: Makes the house smell of whatever the dog would like, which is mostly sausages.
x_air_freshener.lore.epic: Puffed so much pine smell that a squirrel came in through the window looking for the trees.
x_air_freshener.lore.legendary: Made the house smell so much like a forest that a hedgehog moved in for the winter and asked for leaves.

x_almond.lore.rare: Plants itself in any pocket it is left in, so coats sprout tiny almond trees by spring.
x_almond.lore.epic: Was the last nut in the trail mix, and the family hiked an extra mile arguing about who should get it.
x_almond.lore.legendary: Was cracked so cleanly that its shell became a boat, and a ladybird sailed it across the pond.

x_bacon.lore.uncommon: Gets pinched straight off the plate by whoever walks past the kitchen.
x_bacon.lore.rare: Sets off the smoke alarm without any smoke at all, just because it is excited.
x_bacon.lore.epic: Sizzled so loudly on Saturday morning that the radio turned itself down to listen.
x_bacon.lore.legendary: Fried so crispy that it was used as a ladder to rescue the cat from the shed roof.

x_beer.lore.common: Is fizzy ginger beer in a tall glass, so gingery that it makes noses twitch.
x_beer.lore.rare: Grows its foam back every time someone blows it off, so the glass never gets any fuller.
x_beer.lore.epic: Foamed over at the summer fair so much that the cake stall next to it got a fizzy ginger topping.
x_beer.lore.legendary: Grew a head of foam so tall that it drifted off like a cloud and rained ginger beer on the cricket match.

x_bleach.lore.rare: Smells so strong that the bathroom spiders pack their bags the moment its cap clicks.
x_bleach.lore.epic: Was used by the grown-ups on spring-cleaning day, and the bathroom shone so brightly that the family needed sunglasses to brush their teeth.
x_bleach.lore.legendary: Left the bathroom so spotless that the mould wrote a letter of complaint and moved to the neighbour's shed.

x_body_wash.lore.rare: Changes its smell every time it is squeezed: coconut, then pine, then fish fingers.
x_body_wash.lore.legendary: Made one bubble so strong that the whole family stood inside it and floated to the shops.

x_bottle_cap.lore.rare: Screws itself back onto the wrong bottle, so the juice ends up wearing the milk's lid.
x_bottle_cap.lore.epic: Rolled under the fridge, and the hunt turned up the cap plus two lost spoons, a sock and a very old pea.
x_bottle_cap.lore.legendary: Rolled away so far that it did a full lap of the town and finished back on its own bottle.

x_bubble_tea.lore.rare: Fires its pearls at whoever forgot to say thank you to the server.
x_bubble_tea.lore.epic: Was slurped so hard in the cinema that the straw whistled and the film paused to see who it was.
x_bubble_tea.lore.legendary: Had so many pearls that a jeweller tried to buy it and was very disappointed by how chewy they were.

x_candle_jar.lore.rare: Keeps glowing for a minute after it is blown out, just to have the last word.
x_candle_jar.lore.epic: Made the lounge so cosy one evening that the cat, the dog and Grandad all fell asleep in one heap.
x_candle_jar.lore.legendary: Smelled so strongly of cookies that the whole street knocked at the door, and there were no cookies at all.

x_cashew.lore.rare: Turns every peanut it touches into a cashew, so the bowl slowly changes while nobody watches.
x_cashew.lore.epic: Was hidden in Grandad's sleeve at a party so often that his jumper became a nut bowl.
x_cashew.lore.legendary: Curled itself into a crescent so perfect that it was hung in the night sky over the village.

x_chestnut.lore.rare: Pops out of the fire straight into the pocket of whoever is coldest.
x_chestnut.lore.epic: Rolled out of the roasting pan and across the frozen pond, and the ducks played ice hockey with it.
x_chestnut.lore.legendary: Grew into a chestnut tree so tall that the winter market now sets up in its branches, stalls and all.

x_chicken_wing.lore.rare: Glows red when it is too spicy, like a little warning light.
x_chicken_wing.lore.epic: Was eaten so messily at a game night that the dice stuck together and only ever rolled double six.
x_chicken_wing.lore.legendary: Was so spicy that its eater's ears steamed like a kettle, and Gran made a cup of tea with them.

x_chickpeas.lore.rare: Swells to twice its size in water and pushes the lid off any jar it is kept in.
x_chickpeas.lore.epic: Rolled down the stairs one by one and played a tune on every step.
x_chickpeas.lore.legendary: Was planted in a flowerpot by accident and grew a plant that makes hummus by itself.

x_cleaning_spray.lore.epic: Was used by the grown-ups before a party, and the counter got so slippery that the cake slid all the way to the guests.
x_cleaning_spray.lore.legendary: Wiped down the kitchen so thoroughly that the old oven came out looking brand new and asked to have its photo taken.

x_cocoa.lore.rare: Turns any milk in the fridge slightly chocolatey overnight, just by being in the cupboard.
x_cocoa.lore.epic: Was spooned so fast that a brown cloud floated out of the window and dusted the washing on the line.
x_cocoa.lore.legendary: Puffed one cloud so big that it hung over the town all day, and everyone came home smelling of biscuits.

x_coffee_bag.lore.rare: Spills a neat trail of grounds from the cupboard to whoever opened it last.
x_coffee_bag.lore.legendary: Smelled so good that the sleepiest owl in town stayed awake all day and became a morning bird.

x_coffee_beans.lore.uncommon: Rattle in the grinder like hailstones, and the cat hides under the table every morning.
x_coffee_beans.lore.rare: Roll themselves into a heart shape on the counter whenever someone says they need a coffee.
x_coffee_beans.lore.legendary: Woke a hibernating bear in the middle of winter, and it went to work at the office instead.

x_conditioner.lore.epic: Made hair so slippery that the whole family's hair clips slid off and pinged round the bathroom like popcorn.
x_conditioner.lore.legendary: Untangled the knots in a whole fishing net in one wash, and the fishermen named their boat after it.

x_cork.lore.rare: Floats back up to the top of any bottle it is pushed into, however hard anyone tries.
x_cork.lore.legendary: Floated across the ocean with a message tied to it and came back with a reply.

x_detergent_bottle.lore.rare: Turns every white sock pink, even when there is no red sock in the wash.
x_detergent_bottle.lore.legendary: Washed the football team's kit so white that the match stopped because the referee was dazzled.

x_dish_soap.lore.rare: Makes any plate it touches so slippery that it slides out of the rack and back into the sink.
x_dish_soap.lore.epic: Made so many bubbles that the washing-up became a bubble castle, with the teaspoons standing guard.
x_dish_soap.lore.legendary: Lasted through a whole year of birthday parties and still had bubbles left over for the bath.

x_drumstick_chicken.lore.rare: Plays a drumroll on the plate whenever someone reaches for it.
x_drumstick_chicken.lore.legendary: Was so tasty at the family picnic that the ants built a little statue of it out of crumbs.

x_essential_oil_bottle.lore.rare: Makes anyone who sniffs it yawn twice and forget what they came into the room for.
x_essential_oil_bottle.lore.legendary: Calmed the house so much that the dog, the cat and the goldfish all lay down for a nap at the same time.

x_fish_and_chips.lore.uncommon: Gets so much vinegar shaken on it that the paper wrapping goes see-through.
x_fish_and_chips.lore.rare: Smudges the newspaper it is wrapped in until the headlines are all about chips.
x_fish_and_chips.lore.epic: Was carried along the seafront so proudly that the lighthouse turned its beam to follow it.
x_fish_and_chips.lore.legendary: Was battered so big that the fish became a boat, and the family rowed it home using two chips as oars.

x_fish_fillet.lore.rare: Swims round the plate when the lemon is squeezed on it, as if it can hear the sea.
x_fish_fillet.lore.epic: Was cooked for the family dinner, and the cat sang outside the window until it got the skin.
x_fish_fillet.lore.legendary: Flaked so perfectly that every flake turned into a tiny fish and swam back to the sea.
x_fish_fillet.names.legendary: Flakerton, the Fish of Many Fish

x_flour.lore.rare: Rises like dough when spilled, so a small spill becomes a small white hill.
x_flour.lore.legendary: Was sifted so fine that it hung over the town like a morning mist, and the bus drove through it and came out white.

x_fried_chicken.lore.uncommon: Always has one piece that is mostly coating with nothing inside.
x_fried_chicken.lore.rare: Gets crispier the longer it waits, so the last piece could be used as a hammer.
x_fried_chicken.lore.epic: Was shared out of a bucket so fast that the empty bucket was worn as a hat for the rest of the party.
x_fried_chicken.lore.legendary: Crunched so loudly at a family dinner that a passing earthquake thought it had been beaten and went home.

x_gas_can.lore.epic: Was carried out by a grown-up on mowing day, and the lawnmower got so excited that it cut a smiley face into the lawn.
x_gas_can.lore.legendary: Kept the village mower going so long that it mowed the green into a maze, and the sheep still haven't found the way out.

x_gas_cylinder.lore.rare: Hisses a little sigh whenever the barbecue is lit, as if it has seen too many burnt sausages.
x_gas_cylinder.lore.epic: Ran out at the barbecue, so the party finished the burgers in the toaster.
x_gas_cylinder.lore.legendary: Kept a barbecue lit through a whole rainy summer, and the clouds got so hungry that they stopped raining to queue.

x_glass_cleaner.lore.rare: Squeaks a little tune when it is wiped, and the tune is different for every window.
x_glass_cleaner.lore.epic: Cleaned a window so well that the cat sat staring at its reflection all afternoon, waiting for the other cat to move.

x_hand_soap.lore.rare: Gives a little round of foam applause whenever someone washes for the full twenty seconds.
x_hand_soap.lore.epic: Was pumped so hard by a toddler that it foamed up a cloud big enough to hide the toddler.

x_hazelnut.lore.rare: Rolls away from the nutcracker on purpose and hides behind the biscuit tin.

x_hot_sauce.lore.rare: Warms up any dish it is near, so the ice cream next to it melts on its own.
x_hot_sauce.lore.epic: Was spilled on the barbecue, and the flames went so red that the fire engine drove past twice to check.
x_hot_sauce.lore.legendary: Was so hot that one drop on the beach turned the sand beneath it into glass.

x_ink_bottle.lore.rare: Makes any word written with it impossible to spell wrong, which annoys the spelling test.
x_ink_bottle.lore.epic: Was spilled in a calligraphy class, and the blots spelled out a perfect alphabet.
x_ink_bottle.lore.legendary: Wrote a letter so long that the postman needed a wheelbarrow, and the reply came back just as long.

x_jerry_can.lore.epic: Clunked about in the boot so loudly on a bumpy road trip that the family thought a goat had got in.
x_jerry_can.lore.legendary: Clunked so steadily on a long drive that a band in the next car recorded it, and the song reached the radio.

x_juice.lore.rare: Turns its drinker's tongue bright orange for an hour, so everyone knows who finished it.
x_juice.lore.legendary: Was squeezed so fresh that the orange tree outside grew a new orange to replace it before breakfast was over.

x_kebab.lore.rare: Slides its chunks off the stick one by one onto other people's plates.
x_kebab.lore.epic: Was waved so wildly by a hungry uncle that the onion flew over the fence into next door's paddling pool.
x_kebab.lore.legendary: Was so long that its two ends were cooked on different barbecues in different gardens.

x_ketchup.lore.common: Is bright red and gets on every chip, every chin and somehow the ceiling.
x_ketchup.lore.rare: Turns any food it touches red, even the peas, which look very embarrassed.
x_ketchup.lore.legendary: Was slapped out of the bottle so hard that it flew across the cafe and landed perfectly on a hot dog at the far table.

x_kidney_beans.lore.rare: Rolls under the cooker in a little red army whenever the tin is opened.
x_kidney_beans.lore.epic: Made a chilli so warming at the bonfire party that the guests stood round the pot instead of the fire.
x_kidney_beans.lore.legendary: Made a chilli so famous that the pot itself now signs autographs.

x_lemonade.lore.rare: Tastes sweeter for whoever made it and sourer for everyone else.
x_lemonade.lore.epic: Was sold from a garden stall so sour that the customers' faces stayed puckered until the ice-cream van came.
x_lemonade.lore.legendary: Squeezed every lemon in the orchard into one jug, and the lemon trees have been sulking ever since.

x_lentils.lore.rare: Doubles in size when cooked and quietly lifts the saucepan lid to escape.
x_lentils.lore.epic: Were poured into the pan so fast that they sounded like a rainstorm, and the family ran to bring the washing in.
x_lentils.lore.legendary: Made one bowl of soup so warming that the house did not need its heating for a month.

x_maple_syrup.lore.legendary: Was tapped from a tree so old and so sweet that the woodpeckers now queue at it with tiny cups.

x_mayonnaise.lore.rare: Turns any salad it touches into a creamy one, even the fruit salad.
x_mayonnaise.lore.epic: Was squeezed so hard at a picnic that it drew a white line down the blanket, and the two families stayed on their own sides.
x_mayonnaise.lore.legendary: Spread so evenly that the groundsman used it to paint the white lines on the football pitch.

x_meatball.lore.rare: Steers the spaghetti like reins, so it can drive the whole plate across the table.
x_meatball.lore.epic: Was sneezed off the plate at spaghetti night and rolled into the garden, where it grew into a meatball bush.
x_meatball.lore.legendary: Rolled down the hill so far that it gathered every lost pea in town and came back the size of a car.

x_medicine_bottle.lore.epic: Was kept on a shelf so high that the grown-ups needed the stepladder, and the stepladder now lives in the bathroom.
x_medicine_bottle.lore.legendary: Was locked away so safely that even the family's very clever cat gave up after a week of trying.
x_medicine_bottle.names.legendary: Lockwell, Keeper of the Top Shelf

x_milkshake.lore.rare: Is so cold that it freezes the straw solid, so the straw can be eaten as a lolly afterwards.
x_milkshake.lore.epic: Was slurped so hard at a diner that the jukebox skipped and played the same song all afternoon.
x_milkshake.lore.legendary: Was blended so cold that it started a snowstorm in the diner, and the waitress served the burgers on sledges.

x_milkshake_glass.lore.rare: Makes the cherry on top hop over to whoever looks saddest at the table.
x_milkshake_glass.lore.epic: Was piled so high with cream that it needed scaffolding, and a builder in a hard hat carried it to the table.
x_milkshake_glass.lore.legendary: Was so tall that the cherry on top was picked by a passing hot-air balloon.

x_mussel.lore.rare: Clamps onto any spoon that comes near, so the soup spoons come out wearing mussels like hats.
x_mussel.lore.legendary: Opened its shell so wide that it laughed, and the whole pot caught the giggles.

x_mustard.lore.rare: Writes its own name in yellow on every hot dog it is squeezed onto.
x_mustard.lore.epic: Squirted a stripe so straight down the picnic table that the ants used it as a running track.
x_mustard.lore.legendary: Was so hot that the sausage in the bun sat up and said 'ooh'.

x_noodles_packet.lore.rare: Crumbles into a thousand pieces in the bag the moment someone wants it whole.
x_noodles_packet.lore.epic: Was snapped in half so hard that one half flew across the student kitchen into the kettle, which made dinner anyway.
x_noodles_packet.lore.legendary: Cooked itself in three minutes flat on a mountain top using only sunshine, and the climbers had hot dinner at the summit.

x_nugget.lore.rare: Changes shape every time it is turned over: a star, a cloud, then a slightly worried face.
x_nugget.lore.legendary: Was shaped so exactly like a dinosaur that it stomped off the plate and roared at the ketchup.

x_oil_bottle.lore.legendary: Was poured into the town clock so smoothly that it ran backwards, and the whole town got an extra hour in bed.

x_olive_oil.lore.rare: Makes salad leaves stand up and shine as if they are in an advert.
x_olive_oil.lore.epic: Was poured so generously on a salad that the lettuce leaves sailed round the bowl like little boats.
x_olive_oil.lore.legendary: Came from an olive tree so old that it remembers the dinosaurs, and it still says the salads were better then.

x_oyster.lore.rare: Whispers the sound of the sea to anyone who holds it to their ear, then spits water in it.
x_oyster.lore.epic: Snapped shut on the waiter's tie at a fancy dinner, so he served pudding with an oyster on his chest.
x_oyster.lore.legendary: Grew a pearl so big that it could not close its shell, so it uses the pearl as a pillow.
x_oyster.names.legendary: Pearlington, Keeper of the Giant Pearl

x_paint_spray_can.lore.rare: Changes colour to match its user's mood, so grumpy days come out grey.
x_paint_spray_can.lore.epic: Sprayed a model plane so well that the plane took off and looped round the garden.
x_paint_spray_can.lore.legendary: Painted an old rusty bike so beautifully that it rode off on its own to show its friends.

x_pasta_box.lore.rare: Turns spaghetti into penne inside the box when nobody is looking, so every recipe needs changing.
x_pasta_box.lore.legendary: Was opened at the wrong end so many times that it grew a third end.
x_pasta_box.names.legendary: Threender, the Box With Three Ends

x_peanut.lore.rare: Hides an extra nut in its shell for whoever is kindest, and an empty shell for whoever grabs first.
x_peanut.lore.epic: Left so many shells at a football match that the pitch crunched and the ball bounced the wrong way.
x_peanut.lore.legendary: Was cracked open and had a whole tiny peanut farm inside, tractor and all.

x_pecan.lore.common: Splits out of its shell in two halves that never quite fit back together.
x_pecan.lore.rare: Arranges itself in perfect rings on top of every pie, even when it was just thrown on.
x_pecan.lore.epic: Topped a pie so thickly that it had to be cut with a saw at the family dinner.
x_pecan.lore.legendary: Grew on a tree so tall that the squirrels need a lift to reach the top.

x_pistachio.lore.rare: Smiles a little wider whenever someone compliments it, and snaps shut when ignored.
x_pistachio.lore.epic: Snapped shut on Grandad's finger at a party and would not let go until he told a joke.
x_pistachio.lore.legendary: Was the only pistachio in the world that opened itself, so the rest of the bowl made it their leader.

x_propane_tank.lore.common: Sits on the camping stove, white and squat, and hisses a polite hello when a grown-up opens the valve.
x_propane_tank.lore.uncommon: Rattles in the car boot all the way to the campsite like a grumpy drum.
x_propane_tank.lore.rare: Frosts over when it is working hard, so it is the only thing at the campsite wearing a coat of ice.
x_propane_tank.lore.epic: Cooked so many breakfasts on a camping trip that the bears left a thank-you note.
x_propane_tank.lore.legendary: Kept a camping trip going so long that the family forgot their house, and the post is now delivered to the tent.

x_pumpkin_seeds.lore.rare: Pops in the oven like popcorn, and every pop sounds like a tiny ghost saying 'boo'.
x_pumpkin_seeds.lore.epic: Were roasted at a pumpkin carving night and spilled into the lantern, which grinned even wider.
x_pumpkin_seeds.lore.legendary: Were planted in the school field and grew a pumpkin so big that the school held assembly inside it.

x_rice.lore.epic: Spilled into the vacuum cleaner and rattled inside it like a rain stick for a week.
x_rice.lore.legendary: Counted itself one night and found exactly one grain for every person in the world, plus one for the cat.

x_sauce_bottle.lore.rare: Splurts only at whoever said they didn't want any sauce, from across the table.
x_sauce_bottle.lore.epic: Splurted so hard at the chip shop that the fish on the menu board got a brown moustache.
x_sauce_bottle.lore.legendary: Has sat on the same cafe table for so long that it has its own chair and a cup of tea.

x_sesame.lore.rare: Hides between two teeth and pops out exactly in the middle of the school photo.
x_sesame.lore.epic: Was sprinkled so thickly on a bun that the bun turned into a little hedgehog.
x_sesame.lore.legendary: Said 'open' to a cave door once, and the door opened, so now it is kept in the kitchen for stuck jars.

x_shampoo_bottle.lore.rare: Gives its user a different hairstyle every wash, whether they want one or not.
x_shampoo_bottle.lore.legendary: Washed a lion's mane at the zoo so well that it now poses for shampoo adverts.

x_shrimp_plate.lore.epic: Curled up so tightly at a party that the prawns rolled off the plate like little wheels.
x_shrimp_plate.lore.legendary: Curled its prawns in perfect time, and they performed a synchronised swimming show in the sauce.

x_smoothie.lore.uncommon: Separates into stripes if it is left for a minute, like a fruity flag.
x_smoothie.lore.rare: Turns its drinker the colour of its fruit for an hour, so the whole family went green after the spinach one.
x_smoothie.lore.epic: Was carried to school in a flask that burst on the bus, and the whole top deck smelled of mango.
x_smoothie.lore.legendary: Blended a whole orchard into one glass, and the trees outside now stand a little nervously.

x_soy_sauce.lore.rare: Drips out of its bottle only after the sushi has been eaten.
x_soy_sauce.lore.legendary: Seasoned one bowl of rice so perfectly that the rice bowl asked to marry it.

x_soybean.lore.rare: Fires itself out of its pod straight into whoever's mouth is open.
x_soybean.lore.epic: Was popped out of a whole bowl of pods so fast that it rained soybeans on the next table.

x_spray_can.lore.rare: Unsqueaks anything it is sprayed near, including the floorboards, the gate and Grandad's knees.
x_spray_can.lore.legendary: Oiled the creakiest door in the village so well that the ghost who lived behind it had nothing to do and left.

x_steak.lore.rare: Sizzles in a code only the dog understands, so the dog is always first into the kitchen.
x_steak.lore.epic: Was so big at Sunday dinner that it was carried in by two people and a skateboard.
x_steak.lore.legendary: Cooked rare, medium and well done all at once, so everyone at the table got the end they wanted.

x_sugar.lore.rare: Makes every wasp in the room fall in love with whoever is holding it.
x_sugar.lore.epic: Spilled so thickly on the kitchen floor that the robot vacuum got a sugar rush and cleaned the garden too.
x_sugar.lore.legendary: Sweetened the school dinners so much for one day that the cabbage was the first thing to run out.

x_sunflower_seeds.lore.rare: Turns its eater's head to follow the sun all afternoon, like a sunflower.
x_sunflower_seeds.lore.epic: Were dropped in the playground and grew a sunflower so tall that the slide now ends in its petals.
x_sunflower_seeds.lore.legendary: Fed a flock of birds so well that they carried the family's picnic blanket to the beach for them.

x_syrup_bottle.lore.rare: Glues the pancake to the plate, so the plate comes too whenever the pancake is lifted.
x_syrup_bottle.lore.epic: Was squeezed so hard on pancake day that a golden ribbon shot across the kitchen and tied the cupboard doors shut.
x_syrup_bottle.lore.legendary: Poured so slowly that one drip took a whole week, and the family threw a party when it landed.

x_vinegar.lore.rare: Turns any chip soggy from three tables away, just by being shaken in its direction.

x_vinegar_bottle.lore.uncommon: Has a shaker top with one hole that fires sideways, always at the customer.
x_vinegar_bottle.lore.rare: Refills itself overnight, so it has been exactly half full since the chip shop opened.
x_vinegar_bottle.lore.epic: Was shaken so hard at the seaside shop that the spray drifted out to sea and pickled a passing fishing boat.
x_vinegar_bottle.lore.legendary: Shook out one drop so sharp that it woke a sleeping lighthouse, and the lighthouse winks at it every night.

x_vitamin_bottle.lore.uncommon: Is always the last thing packed for holidays and the first thing forgotten.
x_vitamin_bottle.lore.rare: Rattles out a little tune each morning, getting louder until a grown-up picks it up.
x_vitamin_bottle.lore.epic: Rattled so loudly on the bathroom shelf in a storm that the family thought the thunder had come indoors.
x_vitamin_bottle.lore.legendary: Rattled so loudly every morning that the cockerel next door gave up crowing and went back to bed.

x_walnut.lore.epic: Was cracked by the fire with such a bang that the cat leapt onto the curtains and stayed there until supper.
x_walnut.lore.legendary: Looked so much like a brain that it started doing the family's homework, and getting it right.

x_wine_glass_bottle.lore.common: Stands on the table with a long neck, and someone always tries to play it like a flute.
x_wine_glass_bottle.lore.uncommon: Always gets passed to the wrong end of the table, then all the way back again.
x_wine_glass_bottle.lore.legendary: Hummed a note so deep when someone blew across its neck that the cows in the next field mooed back in harmony.
